en: The postcard features a colored illustration of a harbor town with several ships docked in the water and rows of buildings along the waterfront. The townscape includes scattered houses and greenery in the foreground, while a more developed urban area lines the shore. The back of the card is labeled 'BREVKORT' and 'Carte Postale,' indicating its use as a postcard, with address lines and Swedish instructional text.
